text: Thabo's daughter graduates from Leeds on June 3rd. He's flying her grandparents over from Durban for it. Remind me to send a card the week before.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Friday and drop the parcel at the post office. The counter shuts at five.
Dorota said her son Bogdan starts primary school next Tuesday. She's far more nervous about it than he is, apparently.

Graham's mum is having her hip replaced on 5/14. Dr Banerjee is doing the operation. Graham is taking the whole week off to look after her and his dad, who can't really cope on his own anymore. I should call him the weekend after to see how she's getting on.
Spoke to Eva after book club. Her brother Darius has just finished his medical finals and gets his results in a fortnight. She says he's barely sleeping.
Eamon and his wife celebrate their 25th anniversary on July 9th. They're having dinner at the place by the harbour. He hinted she'd love a framed print of their wedding venue.
Remind me to ask Anders how Jonah's driving test went. It was this morning.
Chiara's little girl lost her first tooth yesterday and is now trying to negotiate a better rate with the tooth fairy.
Elif is vegetarian and can't stand coriander. Worth remembering for the barbecue.
Tendai's graduation party has been called off because his grandad is in hospital. Don't forget to message him tomorrow to see how they're all doing.
Akira mentioned her husband Rhys is retiring at the end of the month after thirty years at the council. Must get him a card and maybe a bottle of something nice.
Book the car in for its MOT. It runs out on October 28th.

Dana's twins start nursery on Monday, and she's going back to work part time the same week, so it's going to be chaos in their house. Her mother-in-law is meant to be helping with pickups but has just broken her wrist. Text Dana on Monday evening to see how the first day went.
Mia rang. Her dog Biscuit had an operation on his back leg on Saturday. He's home now but on crate rest for six weeks, which he hates.
Tobi passed his bar exams! Found out today. His parents are throwing him a party on August 25th. I should get him something to mark it.

Caught up with Jada over coffee. Her mum has been unwell since the summer and they finally have a diagnosis appointment on November 4th. Jada is driving up to Glasgow the Sunday before to be with her. Meanwhile her eldest, Imogen, is sitting her GCSE mocks that same week, so Jada is being pulled in every direction and sounds exhausted. I should message her on the 4th, and maybe drop a lasagne round once she's back.
Jack and Teresa are expecting their second baby in March. Teresa has had awful morning sickness, so they haven't told many people yet.
Bogdan Wright from work said his daughter got into Edinburgh to study architecture. He's over the moon.
Sofia is the narrator in the school play on Thursday. Her dad Abebe says she's been practising her lines in the bath every night. Wish her luck on Wednesday.

Yusuf is moving to Bristol in a fortnight for the new job. His girlfriend is staying in London until her lease ends in January, and then they'll look for somewhere together. He seems excited but a bit daunted by the long-distance part.
Note to self: renew passport before the trip. Get the photos done this weekend, then fill in the online form.
Alice told me her sister Kerry has finally finished her PhD. The viva went well and graduation is in December.
Varun's son is in the under-11 cup final on Saturday. Remind me to ask Varun on Sunday how the final went.
Gemma's grandmother passed away last week. The funeral is on Friday at 11 at St Mary's. I'm going with Rhys.
Thabo loves fly fishing and has been dropping hints about a new reel for his birthday in May.
Dorota's daughter graduates on May 14. She's the first in the family to go to university, so it's a big deal for all of them.
Groceries tonight, gym at 7 tomorrow, then the dentist at 2. Busy one.
Graham said his lad failed his driving test again on Tuesday. Third attempt. He's gutted and is talking about giving up altogether.
Eva's mother-in-law is coming to stay for three weeks from next Friday. Eva is not thrilled.
Darius and Chiara got engaged over the weekend! Engagement drinks are on 6/21 at Chiara's parents' house.
Called Anders. Jonah passed his test with only two minors. Proud dad. Send Jonah a congratulations text.
Elif's daughter starts secondary school on September 4th. New uniform, new bus route, the lot. Elif is the nervous one.

Tendai update: his grandad is out of hospital and recovering at home, so the party is back on for August 16th. Tendai asked if I'd say a few words. I'm also bringing the cake. Need to call the bakery tomorrow to order it, and pick it up on the 15th.
Akira's mum turns 80 next Sunday. There's a big family lunch and Akira is in charge of the slideshow, so she wants old photos from everyone.
Return the library books, cancel the gym trial before Thursday, and order more printer ink.
Dana Lewis mentioned her husband Alejandro, Ale for short, works nights at the hospital, so she does all the school runs.
Mia's niece graduated from nursing school on Friday. Mia went down for it and cried through the whole ceremony.
Tobi's sister Giulia has her first day at the bank on Monday. She's been job hunting since spring.
Teresa said Jack's dad has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. He's struggling with all the diet changes. Check in with Jack next week.
Don't forget to ask Abebe whether Sofia's play went well. It was last Thursday and I completely forgot.
Yusuf's little brother sits his maths retake on June 10th. Yusuf is tutoring him at weekends.
Alice's cat Pepper went missing on Sunday. She's put posters up all over the estate.
Kerry Haddad teaches Year 2 in Leeds and is running the Great North Run in September.
Varun and his wife are off to Japan for three weeks from 5/2. Their kids are staying with her parents.
Gemma is back at work after the funeral. She seemed okay but very quiet. I should take her out for lunch next week.
Plan for Saturday: farmers market first thing, then paint the spare room. Sunday is a rest day.
Rhys's daughter finishes uni on June 20th and already has a graduate job lined up in Manchester.
Imogen (Immy) said her son had his first swimming lesson today and refused to get in the pool. Second attempt next Saturday.

Lunch with Chiara and Darius. They want a small wedding next summer, probably in Puglia where Chiara's grandparents live, but Darius's mum is pushing hard for a big church do at home. Chiara seems quite stressed by it all. They're going to look at venues over Easter. Remind me to ask Chiara how it went when they're back.
Eamon's daughter has her grade 3 ballet exam tomorrow at 10. Text him good luck tonight.
Thabo's son is doing his Duke of Edinburgh expedition in the Peaks this weekend. Thabo is convinced it'll rain the whole time.
Dorota and her partner adopted a rescue greyhound called Luna last week. She's very shy and hides behind the sofa.
Pay the council tax, then sort out the boiler service. The engineer can come Wednesday between 8 and 12.
Graham's lad turns 18 on December 2nd. Graham wants him to learn to drive, but he only cares about his guitar. A voucher for a guitar shop would probably go down well.
Remind me to ring Eva on Friday. Darius gets his results that morning.
Jada said her mum's appointment went better than expected. It's not cancer, just a cyst. Huge relief all round.

Bumped into Akira and Rhys at the school gates. Their youngest starts reception in two weeks and their eldest is applying for sixth form. Rhys is counting down to his last day on the 30th and has already bought a canoe for retirement. They've invited me round for dinner a week on Saturday. I'm taking dessert.
Abebe's wife sits her citizenship test on 3/27. She's been revising for months and is really anxious about it.

Teresa mentioned her brother Bogdan has split up with his fiancée and moved back in with their parents. The wedding is off, obviously. He's taking it badly. I should message him this week, and maybe invite him to the pub quiz on Thursday to get him out of the house.
Parents' evening was fine, nothing to note. Just need to buy a new lunchbox and name labels before Monday.
